PART I

Item 1. Business

Cascade Semiconductor designs and sells analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for industrial automation, automotive, and energy infrastructure customers. We operate one wafer fabrication facility in Oregon and rely on third-party foundries for advanced process nodes.

We were incorporated in Oregon in 1988. Our products are sold through a direct sales force and through a global network of distribution partners. Design wins typically precede revenue by twelve to twenty-four months.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

A significant portion of our revenue is concentrated among a small number of distribution partners. In fiscal 2024, our three largest distributors accounted for approximately 44% of consolidated net revenue. The loss of any one of these partners could materially affect our results of operations.

We depend on third-party foundries for advanced process nodes. Capacity constraints at these foundries have periodically extended our lead times and constrained our ability to meet customer demand.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition

Results of Operations. Total net revenue for fiscal 2024 was $2,640 million, a decrease of 6.4% compared with $2,821 million in fiscal 2023. The decline reflected inventory correction among distribution partners in the industrial end market, partially offset by growth in automotive.

Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data

The consolidated financial statements and the report of our independent registered public accounting firm are included beginning on page F-1 of this Annual Report. We have prepared these statements in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States.

Our fiscal year ends on the last Friday of September. Fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2023 each contained 52 weeks.
